source: in-session Claude Code agent (pred-scout-coach) over each artifact role view (kit, build, stages, Eternal, lane augment, matchup verdicts, honesty notes) only; every number ground-checked, failing lines dropped

support.line: Open with Imperial Lash to root and dash in, then Royal Flourish to mesmerize and Iron Rose so your carry's hits on the Thorns target deal bonus true damage. Once Stonewall lands, stand in front and drop Queen's Garden on their engage.
support.watchout: Into Riktor or Narbash you lose early trades; hold Imperial Lash to answer their engage instead of opening with it.

offlane.line: Trade with Imperial Lash to root and close the gap, then Royal Flourish to mesmerize and Iron Rose to tank the reply while the vine ticks. When Mutilator is done near minute 16, start fights with Queen's Garden and burst squishy targets caught inside.
offlane.watchout: Every listed offlane matchup beats you here; farm safely and wait for your jungler before spending Imperial Lash.

jungle.line: Gank from an angle with Imperial Lash so the root and dash land together, then Royal Flourish to mesmerize and Iron Rose to stick on them. With Alternator and Mutilator done by minute 16, use Queen's Garden to trap a squishy target for your team.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang beat you in skirmishes; avoid fighting them in their jungle and take objectives on the opposite side when they show.

offlane.line: Poke with Hellfire, then Web Lash to root and follow with Crushing Maw up close to heal and build Hunger. Once Crescelia is done around minute 14, use Consume to pull a low target in and bite them for the execute.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel and Grux all win long trades here; poke with Hellfire from range and only commit when they burn their engage.

jungle.line: Gank by lashing to terrain with Web Lash and leaping down to stun, then Crushing Maw up close to heal and Hellfire to slow their escape. After Crescelia at minute 14, save Consume for a low target you can bite and execute.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Kwang and Serath out-duel you; skip contested camps against them and gank lanes instead.

support.line: Land Web Lash to root their carry, then Hellfire to slow and Crushing Maw for damage and healing up close. Once Stonewall is done near minute 16, step in front and use Consume to pull divers off your carry.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker and Narbash beat this lane; stay beside your carry and answer their engage instead of throwing Web Lash first.

midlane.line: Poke with Particle Shredder, then land Dread Nova to stun and drop Ether Crystal on them so the pull keeps them in your damage. Once Inquisition is done around minute 15, finish low targets with Synaptic Obliterator, whose beams hit harder on wounded enemies.
midlane.watchout: Every listed mid matchup beats you, so farm with Particle Shredder from max range and save Dread Nova for when they jump you.

support.line: Wait for their engage, then lob Dread Nova to stun and place Ether Crystal under your carry to push divers off and lift your carry into the air. Once Stonewall lands, stand closer and channel Synaptic Obliterator after the enemy uses their dashes.
support.watchout: Riktor and Dekker win this lane; keep your distance and never channel Synaptic Obliterator while they still have a stun ready.

offlane.line: Poke with Particle Shredder to stack Disintegrate, then Dread Nova to stun and Ether Crystal to pull them back into range. With Inquisition done near minute 16, rotate and use Synaptic Obliterator to finish wounded targets from behind your team.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel and Grux all dive you here; play near tower and keep Ether Crystal to push them off when they leap in.

offlane.line: Open with Boreal Sweep to slow, then Glacial Charge in and Hoarfrost to root, and keep hitting to trigger the Frost Storm. Once Crescelia is done around minute 14, follow the root with Cryoseism so the stun and explosion land together.
offlane.watchout: Greystone beats this lane; don't chase him with Glacial Charge, trade short and save Hoarfrost for when he leaps at you.

jungle.line: Gank with Glacial Charge to cut off the escape, then Hoarfrost to root and Boreal Sweep for damage while the Frost Storm builds. Once Crescelia lands around minute 14, add Cryoseism on the rooted target to burst a squishy enemy.
jungle.watchout: Kwang wins this duel; don't contest his camps alone, gank the lane farthest from him instead.

support.line: Play for the pick: Glacial Charge in, Hoarfrost to root, Boreal Sweep to slow, then Cryoseism while they're held. Once Raiment of Renewal is done around minute 18, stay in front longer and peel divers off your carry with Hoarfrost.
support.watchout: Dekker wins this lane; wait for her to use her stun before you charge in.

offlane.line: Leap in with Skull Crusher to shred armor, then Cursed Edge so the third slash stuns, and Dire Howl to heal back what you took. Once The Perforator is done near minute 16, finish a squishy target with Kingslayer.
offlane.watchout: Every listed offlane matchup wins this lane; trade short, farm near tower, and save Kingslayer for your jungler's gank.

jungle.line: Gank with Skull Crusher to shred armor, then land all three Cursed Edge slashes on one target for the stun and bleed. Once The Perforator lands around minute 16, use Kingslayer on a squishy target and Dire Howl to heal through the fight.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Kwang and Serath beat you head-on; don't fight them in their jungle, gank lanes when they show elsewhere.

support.line: Hold Cursed Edge for its third-slash stun when they step up, then Skull Crusher to follow and Dire Howl to slow and heal. After Stonewall around minute 16, stand in front and use Kingslayer to remove the diver on your carry.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker and Narbash beat this lane; let them engage first and answer with Cursed Edge instead of leaping in.

jungle.line: Mark the target with Detection Protocol, follow the trail and Chrono Swipe in, then Primeval Roar to fear them while your canisters stack. Once Crescelia is done around minute 14, finish with Ursine Burst to grab and slam a squishy target.
jungle.watchout: Every listed jungle matchup, Khaimera and Kwang included, out-duels you; avoid contested camps and gank lanes for early kills.

offlane.line: Trade with Chrono Swipe and basic attacks until the Tesseract Core is up, using Primeval Roar to fear them when they hit back. Once Crescelia is done near minute 14, use Detection Protocol to chase and Ursine Burst to slam a fleeing target.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel and Grux all beat you in lane; trade short and wait for your jungler instead of forcing Ursine Burst.

midlane.line: Shadow Slip in and hit with Eventide so Blood Tithe applies Haemorrhage, then Blade Siphon to heal and re-trigger Shadow Slip to escape. Once Wraith Leggings lands around minute 15, use Feast on a bleeding target for the bonus damage and heal.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and Iggy & Scorch beat this lane; don't Shadow Slip in while their burst is ready, farm and roam instead.

offlane.line: Trade with Eventide and Shadow Slip to apply Haemorrhage, then Blade Siphon to heal back and swap to your Shadow to leave. With Wraith Leggings done near minute 16, follow up with Feast on the bleeding target.
offlane.watchout: Greystone wins this lane; keep trades short and keep the Shadow Slip swap ready for when he leaps at you.

jungle.line: Gank with Shadow Slip and Eventide to apply Haemorrhage, then Feast on the bleeding target for the bonus damage and heal. Once Wraith Leggings is done around minute 15, use Blade Siphon in fights to keep yourself healthy.
jungle.watchout: Kwang beats you in a duel; avoid his side of the jungle and fight only when your laners are near.

offlane.line: Weave a basic attack after every ability to cut your cooldowns, and spend Turbo Crunch on an empowered Right Crunch to knock them up. Once Spear Of Desolation is done near minute 16, cast Re-Crunch right after your strongest ability, since it repeats the last ability you used.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel and Grux all beat this lane; farm safely and save Forward Crunch to escape their engage.

jungle.line: Gank with Forward Crunch, then empowered Right Crunch to knock them up and Left Crunch, weaving basic attacks between abilities. Once Spear Of Desolation lands around minute 15, use Re-Crunch to repeat the knock-up or the true-damage swing.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang beat you head-on; avoid their camps and gank lanes when they show elsewhere.

support.line: Play for picks: throw Stasis Bomb from long range for a longer stun, then Photon Disruptor and Containment Fence to trap them. Once Stonewall lands near minute 18, drop Ion Strike on the fenced target so they're stunned in the center.
support.watchout: Your stun is the team's engage; if you burn Stasis Bomb on poke, back off until it's ready again.

offlane.line: Poke with Photon Disruptor, then land Stasis Bomb from range and Containment Fence to keep them trapped. Once Noxia is done near minute 16, follow the stun with Ion Strike centered on them to stun again.
offlane.watchout: Greystone beats this lane; keep Containment Fence to block his leap and don't trade while Stasis Bomb is down.

midlane.line: Poke with Photon Disruptor, then land Stasis Bomb and fence them in with Containment Fence. Once Noxia lands around minute 15, follow with Ion Strike on the trapped target, and use Rocket Boots to rotate faster with your team.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and Iggy & Scorch out-poke you; play behind minions and save Stasis Bomb for when they step forward.

carry.line: Turn on Rad Rounds and basic attack, then pop the stacks with Old Rusty and use Gag Grenade to silence the target. Once Viper is done near minute 16, finish with Shrapnel Cannon, firing it in the air to escape divers.
carry.watchout: Sparrow and Murdock win this lane; farm safely and use Gag Grenade defensively when they engage.

offlane.line: Trade with Old Rusty, then Rad Rounds and basic attacks, popping the stacks early with Old Rusty again. Once Viper is done around minute 16, finish with Shrapnel Cannon, and save the in-air blast to escape a dive.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel and Grux all dive you; stay near tower and keep Shrapnel Cannon for escaping, not chasing.

midlane.line: Clear and poke with Old Rusty, then land Gag Grenade to silence before Rad Rounds and basic attacks. Once Viper lands near minute 16, finish wounded targets with Shrapnel Cannon and save the in-air blast for escapes.
midlane.watchout: Lt. Belica, Gideon and Iggy & Scorch beat this lane; play behind minions and use Gag Grenade to stop their combo.

carry.line: Poke in ranged stance with Tachyon Lance, then Zero Shift to melee and Talon Drive in for Axiom Strike up close. Once Viper is done near minute 16, keep hitting heroes to build Heat and fire Limit Break when you overheat.
carry.watchout: Sparrow, Murdock and Drongo beat this lane; stay ranged and don't switch to melee until they've used their escape.

offlane.line: Open ranged with Sidewind and Tachyon Lance, then Zero Shift to melee and Talon Drive in for Axiom Strike, healing from the melee stance. Once Viper is done around minute 16, keep damage on heroes to overheat and unlock Limit Break.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel and Grux all win this lane; stay ranged and only switch to melee after their leap is used.

midlane.line: Poke in ranged stance with Tachyon Lance, and Zero Shift to melee only when Talon Drive and Axiom Strike can land. Once Viper is done near minute 16, keep damage on heroes to build Heat and finish with Limit Break.
midlane.watchout: Most mid matchups beat you, including Gideon and Lt. Belica; farm ranged and roam instead of forcing melee trades.

jungle.line: Gank with Reaping Dash, then Hamstring on a single target to slow and hit harder, holding Safeguard to block their key ability. Once The Perforator is done near minute 16, finish with Earth Shatter to execute and recast it after executing a hero.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Kwang and Serath beat you head-on; don't fight them in their jungle, take kills in lanes instead.

offlane.line: Trade with Hamstring on the lone laner and block their best ability with Safeguard. Once The Perforator is done near minute 16, close with Reaping Dash and execute with Earth Shatter; the takedown cuts Reaping Dash's cooldown so you can dash again.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel and Grux all beat this lane; farm safely and wait for a gank before spending Earth Shatter.

midlane.line: Throw Sticky Mine and basic attack the target to empower it, then stop Seek and Destroy over them and use Security Gate to root. Once Orion lands near minute 15, drop Tesla Dome on rooted enemies in fights.
midlane.watchout: Gideon beats this lane; stay behind minions and keep Security Gate ready to stop his engage.

support.line: Stick Sticky Mine on your carry's target, empower it with a basic attack, and use Security Gate to root divers or speed up your team. Once Stonewall is done near minute 16, place Tesla Dome where enemies have to fight inside it.
support.watchout: Dekker trades evenly with you; don't waste Security Gate early, save it for her engage.

offlane.line: Poke with Sticky Mine plus a basic attack to empower it, and stop Seek and Destroy above them to slow. Once Orion is done near minute 16, root a target with Security Gate and drop Tesla Dome on them.
offlane.watchout: If the enemy jungler shows, stop poking and hold Security Gate to root the first diver.

midlane.line: Poke with Void Breach to slow, then Cosmic Rift on the slowed target and a basic attack to tether and root them. Once Orion is done near minute 15, use Torn Space to reposition and land Black Hole on grouped enemies.
midlane.watchout: Black Hole keeps you channeling for 2.75s before you can act; cast it only after the enemy has used their dashes and stuns.

support.line: Slow with Void Breach, then Cosmic Rift on the target and a basic attack to tether and root them for your carry. Once Stonewall is done near minute 16, use Torn Space to bring your team in and Black Hole when they group.
support.watchout: Channeling Black Hole leaves you open; if divers still have their engage ready, hold it and peel for your carry instead.

offlane.line: Trade with Void Breach and Cosmic Rift, then a basic attack to tether and root. Once Orion lands near minute 16, use Torn Space to reach fights and Black Hole on grouped enemies.
offlane.watchout: If the enemy jungler arrives, save Torn Space to escape rather than using it to chase.

offlane.line: Leap in with Assault The Gates, then Make Way to shred armor and Sacred Oath's empowered hit to slow. Once The Perforator is done near minute 16, save Stone Forged Soul to heal when low and crash down on the enemies around you.
offlane.watchout: Steel trades evenly with you; don't leap into him without your jungler, trade with Make Way and back off.

jungle.line: Gank with Assault The Gates, then Make Way to shred armor and Sacred Oath to slow their escape. Once The Perforator lands around minute 16, use Stone Forged Soul in fights to heal back and slam the enemies nearby.
jungle.watchout: Kwang beats you in a duel; avoid his camps and gank lanes when he shows elsewhere.

midlane.line: Clear with Make Way and Sacred Oath, then leap in with Assault The Gates when a target is close. Once The Perforator is done near minute 16, save Stone Forged Soul to heal back when low and crash on whoever stayed.
midlane.watchout: Gideon beats this lane; don't leap in while his slow is ready, farm and roam instead.

carry.line: Farm in Sentry Mode to stack attack speed, then switch with Assault Mode to hit from long range and use Displacement Blast to push divers away. Once Prophecy lands near minute 15, block their key ability with Energy Shield and finish with GTFO.
carry.watchout: GTFO slows you while it locks on; don't channel it with a diver nearby, keep Energy Shield ready instead.

midlane.line: Farm in Sentry Mode, then use Assault Mode for long-range poke and Displacement Blast to knock divers off you. Once Prophecy is done near minute 15, block their burst with Energy Shield and finish runners with GTFO.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and Iggy & Scorch beat this lane; play back and hold Energy Shield for their main ability.

offlane.line: Poke in Assault Mode from long range, and use Displacement Blast to knock them back when they charge. Once Prophecy is done near minute 16, hold Energy Shield for their engage and finish with GTFO.
offlane.watchout: If the enemy jungler joins, skip GTFO and walk back to tower with Energy Shield ready.

offlane.line: Basic attack to stack Bloodlust, then Double Pain to heal and Smash 'n Grab to pull them in and stun. Once Viper is done near minute 16, open with Stampede and Warlord's Challenge to win long fights.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel and Aurora beat this lane; trade short and only use Stampede with your jungler nearby.

jungle.line: Gank with Stampede to drag them, then Smash 'n Grab to stun and Double Pain to heal while Bloodlust stacks. Once Viper lands near minute 16, use Warlord's Challenge on a hero with full Bloodlust stacks so hitting them keeps it going longer.
jungle.watchout: Kwang beats you head-on; avoid his camps and fight him only with your laners around.

support.line: Hold Smash 'n Grab to pull a diver off your carry, then Double Pain to heal and Stampede to drag targets into your team. Once Stonewall lands near minute 18, step in front and use Warlord's Challenge to stun everyone nearby.
support.watchout: Riktor and Dekker beat this lane; don't charge in with Stampede first, answer their engage.

midlane.line: Poke with R2000 Missile from range and lay H11 Cluster Grenades to slow anyone who walks in. Once Orion is done near minute 15, use Land Mine to stun divers and Make It Rain on enemies grouped around an objective.
midlane.watchout: Gideon trades evenly with you; don't hover for R2000 Missile when his burst can reach you.

offlane.line: Poke with R2000 Missile and keep H11 Cluster Grenades between you and them to slow any charge. Once Orion is done near minute 16, knock divers back with Land Mine and use Make It Rain in team fights.
offlane.watchout: If the enemy jungler arrives, drop Land Mine at your own feet to blast yourself away instead of trading.

carry.line: Drop H11 Cluster Grenades to slow them and lob Land Mine to knock them back and stun, then poke with R2000 Missile from range. Once Combustion and Orion land, weave basic attacks between abilities so Armed Salvo refills your mana and keeps the rotation going.
carry.watchout: If a diver reaches you before Land Mine is ready, stop charging missiles and walk back to your team instead of hovering in place.

midlane.line: Plant Flame Turret near the wave, roll Oil Spill through the enemy, then ignite it with Molotov to burn them while your turrets keep firing. Once Orion and Wraith Leggings are done, hold Inferno for when they're slowed in the oil next to your turrets.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and Gadget win this lane on our read; set turrets under your tower and farm instead of trading until your second item.

offlane.line: Set Flame Turrets at the edge of the wave so the lane fights on your ground, then land Oil Spill and ignite it with Molotov. With Combustion and Orion done, start trades by rolling oil into them and finish with Inferno while turrets keep shooting.
offlane.watchout: Greystone wins this lane on our read; if he walks through your turrets, back off under tower and let turrets poke instead of trading.

support.line: Keep Flame Turrets near your carry, roll Oil Spill at whoever dives them, then Molotov to ignite it and slow the chase. As Stonewall and Vainglory come in, stand in front and save Inferno for when the enemy commits onto your carry.
support.watchout: Dekker wins this lane on our read; stop trading forward and keep Oil Spill to slow anyone who dives your carry.

carry.line: Drop Hydroclasm on the enemy to slow them, pop it with Brine for the burst, then throw Narcosis to hold them in place. Once Orion and Wraith Leggings are done, save Genesis to finish anyone escaping, since it fires through walls.
carry.watchout: Murdock wins this lane on our read; if Narcosis misses, stop chasing and farm with Brine from range instead of trading back.

midlane.line: Last-hit with Brine for the bonus gold, and when the enemy steps up, land Narcosis first so Hydroclasm and Brine hit a held target. After Tainted Scepter, look for Genesis through walls to finish anyone fleeing.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and Iggy & Scorch win this lane on our read; while Narcosis is down, don't trade, just clear the wave and wait.

support.line: Throw Narcosis at whoever steps onto your carry, then place Hydroclasm between you so its slow keeps them off, popping it with Brine as they walk through. As Stonewall and Vainglory finish, stand forward and save Genesis to knock up a dive.
support.watchout: Dekker wins this lane on our read; hold Narcosis for Dekker's engage instead of using it to poke, and back up when it's down.

jungle.line: Close in with Shadow Walk, open with Crippling Dagger so Death Mark lands, then Shadow Dance onto the marked target for double damage. With Alternator and Viper done, finish with Guillotine once they're low, since it hits harder the more health they're missing.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang win this matchup on our read; don't duel them in your jungle, take camps on the far side and hunt picks elsewhere.

jungle.line: Jump in with Ambush to slow them, Unleash for fast attacks, and press Invigorate when you are slowed or low to cleanse and heal. With Alternator and Manta Scythe done, save Cull for grouped or fleeing enemies, since it stuns everyone in front of you.
jungle.watchout: Kwang wins this matchup on our read; don't fight him one-on-one in his jungle, trade camps and gank lanes instead.

offlane.line: Trade with basic attacks to build Rage, Ambush when they're low since it hits harder on missing health, then Unleash and hold Invigorate to cleanse their slows and heal. Once Manta Scythe and The Perforator are done, open fights with Cull on grouped enemies.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Grux and Aurora win this lane on our read; farm safely, keep Invigorate for their engage, and let your jungler start fights.

carry.line: Stack Vengeance with Wrath and Mercy, then pop Dusk to burst everyone marked, using Shadow Glide to dodge and reset it on takedowns. As Deathstalker and Viper land, fire Purge once the fight is committed and enemies are close, since it also cuts their healing.
carry.watchout: Murdock wins this lane on our read; don't trade into him early, farm with Mercy from range and save Shadow Glide to escape.

midlane.line: Poke with Mercy to put Vengeance on, keep attacking to stack it, then cash it in with Dusk, and Shadow Glide out if they jump you. Once Manta Scythe is done, roam with Shadow Glide resets and drop Purge on grouped fights.
midlane.watchout: Lt. Belica, Gideon and Iggy & Scorch win this lane on our read; clear from max range and save Shadow Glide for escaping.

offlane.line: Stack Vengeance with Wrath from range, Mercy when they walk up, then Dusk to burst, keeping Shadow Glide for when the bruiser closes in. With Deathstalker and Viper done, fight beside your team and fire Purge on divers to cut their healing.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel and Aurora win this lane on our read; if they reach you, Shadow Glide away and stop trading until your team arrives.

jungle.line: Throw Judgement of the Heavens to tether them, dash through with Surge of the Heavens to recall the blade, then Light of the Heavens to hit and shield. After Orion and Prophecy, keep the blade energized, and throw it ahead first so Fury of the Heavens teleports you in.
jungle.watchout: If Judgement of the Heavens misses, keep Surge of the Heavens to get out instead of face-tanking the whole enemy team.

offlane.line: Throw Judgement of the Heavens, dash back to it with Surge of the Heavens to recall it, and shield up with Light of the Heavens. After Prophecy, use abilities between basic attacks so the energized blade keeps your damage up in long trades.
offlane.watchout: If they gank while your blade is on the ground, save Fury of the Heavens to teleport out to it.

support.line: Throw Judgement of the Heavens at whoever your carry is hitting, then Surge of the Heavens in and shield with Light of the Heavens. As Stonewall and Raiment of Renewal finish, stand in front and slow the whole fight with Fury of the Heavens.
support.watchout: Dekker wins this lane on our read; don't dash in alone, wait for your carry to commit before throwing the blade.

carry.line: Fire Saturation Charge to slow them, cook Frag Order to launch them, then keep shooting K-75 Storm Rifle while they're slowed. Once Sky Splitter and Spectra are done, drop Rally Point so your team moves faster, and aim Orbital Sanction at whoever runs.
carry.watchout: Every listed carry wins this lane on our read, so farm near tower, avoid early trades, and save Rally Point for team fights.

midlane.line: Shove waves with Saturation Charge, launch yourself out with Frag Order when they jump you, and only trade after the magazine has refilled. With Sky Splitter and Spectra done, rotate to fights and open with Orbital Sanction on the enemy backline.
midlane.watchout: Every listed mid wins this lane on our read; clear and rotate instead of dueling, and keep Frag Order to escape.

offlane.line: Lay Saturation Charge in front of the bruiser, keep firing K-75 Storm Rifle as they walk through the mines, and use Frag Order to launch them off you. After Sky Splitter and Spectra, plant Rally Point in team fights so allies speed in.
offlane.watchout: Every listed offlaner wins this lane on our read; if they reach you, launch away with Frag Order and wait for help.

midlane.line: Drop Void Drone over the enemy to drain their mana, place Void Bomb under them, then Seismic Assault to stun. With Combustion and Wraith Leggings done, finish with Neural Disruptor once their mana is low, since it hits harder the more mana is missing.
midlane.watchout: Gideon, Iggy & Scorch and Gadget win this lane on our read; keep Seismic Assault for when they engage and clear waves from range.

support.line: Place Void Drone in the brush ahead of your carry for vision, and hold Seismic Assault for whoever steps in so your carry can follow up. As Stonewall and Vainglory finish, stand in front and save Neural Disruptor to silence the enemy's main threat.
support.watchout: Dekker wins this lane on our read; don't trade first, wait for the engage and answer it with Seismic Assault.

carry.line: Poke with OA-S3000 SMG, drop Void Bomb on the wave when they walk up, and save Seismic Assault to stun anyone who dives your lane. Once Combustion and Wraith Leggings are done, chain Seismic Assault into Neural Disruptor to finish a low-mana target.
carry.watchout: Murdock wins this lane on our read; stay out of his range, use Void Drone to watch for ganks, and farm safely.

support.line: Lob Maco Gift! on your carry after trades to heal them, and detonate Maco Sparkle! early on whoever dives for the stun. As Lifecore and Noxia land, jump in with Maco Fly! for the slow and shield, then Maco Strike! to push them away.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Narbash win this lane on our read; stay behind your carry and save Maco Strike! to stop their engage.

midlane.line: Open with a long-range Maco Sparkle! so the stun lasts longer, then land Maco Fly! for the slow and shield, and finish with Maco Gift! damage. Once Combustion is done by minute 9, hunt squishy targets and heal yourself between trades.
midlane.watchout: Lt. Belica, Valmont, Gideon and Iggy & Scorch all beat you here, so stop trading, farm from range and wait for your jungler.

offlane.line: Poke with Maco Gift! and keep moving to build Mach Speed!, then throw Maco Sparkle! from long range and follow with Maco Fly! for the slow and shield. Once Combustion and Wraith Leggings are done by minute 16, start those trades yourself.
offlane.watchout: Every offlaner listed beats Maco here, so heal yourself with Maco Gift!, save Maco Strike! to stop their all-in, and wait for your jungler.

midlane.line: Mark your lane opponent with Mark, slow them with Hive, then keep abilities landing to stack Pestilence before you finish with Curse on the marked target. After Orion and Timewarp, use Swarm to dive through and heal, but only when Curse is ready.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and Iggy & Scorch win this lane on our read; keep Swarm to escape and don't spend Curse until they're low.

offlane.line: Mark the bruiser, Hive to slow them, then poke with Fetid Dagger to keep Pestilence ticking while Mark heals you back. Once Spirit Of Amir is done, step into fights with Swarm and land Curse on the marked target.
offlane.watchout: Greystone wins this lane on our read; if he closes the gap, Swarm away instead of trading health.

support.line: Mark the enemy carry so your damage heals you, Hive whoever dives your carry, and keep Fetid Dagger hitting to refresh Pestilence. As Lifecore and Noxia finish, save Curse to finish the marked target your carry is fighting.
support.watchout: Dekker wins this lane on our read; don't walk forward to Mark, stay behind your carry and Hive the engage instead.

support.line: Wind up Abduct to pull an enemy in, then Beguile around them and drop Contagion on your team so everyone heals and gains armor. Once Lifecore and Noxia are done, cast Eclipse to blind the enemy right before your team starts a fight.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker, Phase and Narbash win this lane on our read; don't channel Abduct in the open, stay behind minions and wait for your jungler.

offlane.line: Trade with Clobber so Extract heals you, channel Beguile when they commit, and use Contagion to soak the damage back. With Orion and Noxia done, pull a target in with Abduct and save Eclipse to open fights.
offlane.watchout: Every listed offlaner wins this lane on our read; farm near tower, keep Contagion for ganks, and roam with Eclipse instead of dueling.

jungle.line: Clear camps with Clobber so Extract keeps your health up, then gank by channeling Abduct from out of sight and following with Beguile. Once Orion and Noxia are done, cast Eclipse before an objective fight so the enemy can't see your team coming.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Kwang and Serath win this matchup on our read; don't contest them in your jungle, take the opposite side and gank lanes instead.

carry.line: Set Static Trap where they stand to last-hit, Buckshot them when they step on it to shred armor, then keep firing The Enforcer. With Deathstalker and Viper done, use Hot Pursuit for attack speed in fights and finish runners with Long Arm of the Law.
carry.watchout: If a diver lands on you with Hot Pursuit down, Buckshot them away and back off instead of trading up close.

offlane.line: Drop Static Trap at the edge of the wave so the bruiser has to walk over it, then Buckshot them back and keep basic attacking. After Deathstalker and Viper, fire Long Arm of the Law to help other lanes from where you stand.
offlane.watchout: Greystone and Steel win this lane on our read; when they close in, Buckshot them away and retreat instead of standing your ground.

midlane.line: Land basic attacks to charge Shots Fired, then poke from the extra range and set Static Trap to punish them stepping forward. Once Manta Scythe is done, rotate with Hot Pursuit and use Long Arm of the Law to finish fights elsewhere on the map.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and Iggy & Scorch win this lane on our read; stay behind the wave, trap the brushes, and take farm instead of trades.

support.line: Throw Alacrity to shield your carry before trades, drop Consecrated Ground under them during fights, and fully charge Serenity to stun anyone who dives. Once Lifecore and Noxia finish, watch the whole map and fly in with Reversal Of Fortune to save an ally.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Narbash win this lane on our read; don't charge Serenity in the open, stay behind your carry with Alacrity ready.

support.line: Keep Song Of My People on, Thunk whoever dives your carry to stun them, and press March! when your team engages or needs to escape. After Wraith Leggings and Oblivion Crown, walk into fights with Crash Bang Boom! to slow and mesmerize grouped enemies.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker and Phase win this lane on our read; save Thunk for their engage and don't walk past your minions.

jungle.line: Clear with the healing Song Of My People on, then gank with March! for speed and stun the target with Thunk. After Prophecy and Orion, stay near your team, since Mosh Pit grows with nearby heroes, and channel Crash Bang Boom! in group fights.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Kwang and Serath win this matchup on our read; don't duel them alone, group with a lane before contesting their jungle.

offlane.line: Stun with Thunk, keep Song Of My People on, and use March! to chase or heal before dropping Crash Bang Boom! on a target standing next to you. Once Prophecy and Orion are done by minute 16, stay in longer and keep swinging Drumclubs.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett, Grux and Aurora all win this lane, so farm safely and save Thunk to stop their all-in until help arrives.

midlane.line: Throw Data Burst to slow them, send L.I.N.X through for damage both ways, then Erase Vector in for an empowered Jolt; three casts make your next ability Overclocked. Once Combustion and Orion are online, open fights with Final Thread so every ability hits Overclocked.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and Iggy & Scorch win this lane on our read; keep Erase Vector to dodge their engage and poke only from max range.

support.line: Land Data Burst on whoever dives your carry, and save an Overclocked Data Burst to mesmerize them as well as slow them. As Warp Stream and Stonewall finish, use Final Thread in fights so L.I.N.X and Data Burst keep enemies off your carry.
support.watchout: Riktor and Dekker win this lane on our read; stand behind your carry and keep Erase Vector to dodge their engage.

offlane.line: Dash in with Erase Vector, hit the empowered Jolt, then cast L.I.N.X and Data Burst so your next ability comes out Overclocked. Once Orion is done by minute 16, open fights with Final Thread and save its recast bomb for low-health targets.
offlane.watchout: Every offlaner listed beats Neon here, so don't dash in to trade; poke with L.I.N.X from range and wait for your jungler.

support.line: Link your carry with Telekinetic Link, channel Energy Lance on their target until it roots, and Psychic Flare when the enemy faces you. Once Warp Stream and Raiment of Renewal are done, press Hyperflux when your carry commits so both of you hit faster.
support.watchout: Riktor and Dekker win this lane on our read; if they reach your carry, reactivate Telekinetic Link to pull your carry back to you.

midlane.line: Link a roaming ally or your jungler, channel Energy Lance until the target is rooted, then Psychic Flare to blind them. After Orion and Spirit Of Amir, rotate to fights and press Hyperflux with your linked ally to win them.
midlane.watchout: Lt. Belica, Gideon and Iggy & Scorch win this lane on our read; don't stand still channeling Energy Lance against them, poke and back off.

offlane.line: Channel Energy Lance until its stacking slow roots them, then step in with Psychic Flare to blind and lower your Blink cooldown. Once Orion and Spirit Of Amir finish by minute 15, link your jungler with Telekinetic Link and Hyperflux into fights.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett, Grux and Aurora all win this lane, so stop trading, farm under your tower and wait for your jungler.

jungle.line: Carry Boulder Throw into a gank, throw it to stun, then Pounce in and Rumble to slow so they can't walk away. With Inquisition and Mutilator done, turn on Behemoth before a fight to soak damage and heal while your team follows.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang win this matchup on our read; don't fight them in your jungle, gank lanes and trade objectives instead.

offlane.line: Throw Boulder Throw to stun, Pounce in, and Rumble to keep them slowed while you trade with Swipe. After Inquisition and Mutilator, start fights with Behemoth first so the extra health and healing carry you through.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Grux, Aurora and Scarlett win this lane on our read; farm safely and save Pounce to escape ganks instead of trading.

support.line: Hold Boulder Throw out of sight and throw it to stun whoever walks up on your carry, then Pounce to launch them away. As Inquisition and Stonewall finish, go Behemoth before fights and stand in front to absorb the damage.
support.watchout: Riktor and Dekker win this lane on our read; don't throw the boulder first, keep it to answer their engage.

midlane.line: Launch Mortal Coil to pull them in, follow with Stupor to mesmerize, then hit Soulfire while they're stuck, grabbing Essence from kills to power it up. After Orion and Noxia, use Abyssal Rift to teleport into fights your team has already started.
midlane.watchout: Lt. Belica, Gideon, Iggy & Scorch and Gadget win this lane on our read; farm from range and keep Stupor for their engage.

support.line: Save Stupor for whoever dives your carry, then drop Mortal Coil on them so they get pulled back in. As Warp Stream and Stonewall finish, stand in front and teleport with Abyssal Rift to wherever your carry needs help.
support.watchout: Riktor and Dekker win this lane on our read; don't use Stupor to poke, hold it until they commit.

offlane.line: Poke with Soulfire through the wave, throw Mortal Coil when they step in, and keep Stupor to stop their engage. Once Orion and Noxia are done, use Abyssal Rift to join your team's fights instead of dueling in lane.
offlane.watchout: Every listed offlaner wins this lane on our read; farm near tower and look to join team fights with Abyssal Rift.

carry.line: Hit your target with Scar so the stacks root them, fire Obliterate so the missiles focus them, then finish with the last round of Fate, which always crits. Once Plasma Blade and Deathstalker are done, use Reckoning to pull a carry out of the fight.
carry.watchout: Sparrow, TwinBlast, Murdock, Drongo and Eden win this lane on our read; farm safely and save Reckoning for when their carry is already low.

midlane.line: Throw Scar on the target to set up the root, follow with Obliterate, then land Fate's final crit round, fighting only when your reload is done. After Plasma Blade and Deathstalker, roam and pull isolated targets into the Nether Realm with Reckoning.
midlane.watchout: Renna, Lt. Belica, Valmont, Gideon and Iggy & Scorch win this lane on our read; clear the wave and roam instead of dueling.

offlane.line: Hit their bruiser with Scar and keep shooting so the stacks are used up and they get rooted, then back off while Fate reloads. Once Plasma Blade and Deathstalker are done, use Reckoning to isolate their carry in team fights instead of their frontline.
offlane.watchout: Every listed offlaner wins this lane on our read; farm near tower and only fight when your jungler is close.

support.line: Land Riplash to pull a target into your carry, Shock Therapy to silence them, then turn on Electrocute as you stand in front. As Stonewall and Raiment of Renewal finish, save Skewer for when several enemies line up in front of you.
support.watchout: Dekker wins this lane on our read; don't throw Riplash first into Dekker, keep it to pull a diver off your carry.

jungle.line: Gank from fog with Riplash to pull the target, Shock Therapy to silence them, then Electrocute for the shield while you basic attack. Once Orion and Prophecy are done, look for Skewer to lock down several enemies at an objective.
jungle.watchout: Kwang wins this matchup on our read; don't duel him in the jungle, track his camps and gank the other side.

offlane.line: Open with Riplash to pull your target in, Shock Therapy to silence them, then keep Electrocute up and basic attack; save Skewer for enemies lined up in front. After Orion and Prophecy by minute 16, stay in longer basic-attack trades.
offlane.watchout: If Riplash misses, don't walk in after them; back off and wait for it before trading again, especially into Greystone.

offlane.line: Dash in with First Intent, then land Ashen Vow and Minueta's stabs, and use Swan Song to restrain a target that tries to run; your blade stays Ablaze afterward for extra stabs. After Resolution and The Perforator by minute 16, aim your combo at squishy targets, not the enemy frontline.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Grux and Aurora win long trades against you, so farm safely and save your all-in for when your jungler arrives.

jungle.line: Gank from behind with First Intent, then land Ashen Vow and Minueta's stabs, and use Swan Song to restrain a target that tries to run; your blade stays Ablaze afterward for extra stabs. After Resolution and The Perforator by minute 16, hunt squishy laners instead of fighting the frontline head-on.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang beat you in a straight duel, so don't contest their camps; farm and gank the opposite side of the map.

midlane.line: Push the wave, then dash in with First Intent and Minueta's stabs for a quick trade before stepping out. After Resolution and The Perforator by minute 16, roam to side lanes and use Swan Song to hold a target for your team.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and Iggy & Scorch outrange you, so stop walking into their poke; stay behind minions until they waste their abilities.

jungle.line: Dive onto a target with Ascend, slow them with Chastise, then use Heaven's Fury to dodge their answer while it keeps striking. After Alternator and Mutilator by minute 16, start fights with Heresy and grab the visage each takedown leaves to keep it going.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang win the straight duel, so skip their camps and gank lanes instead of fighting them in the jungle.

offlane.line: Trade short: Chastise to slow, Heaven's Fury to strike and dodge their reply, then walk back to your minions. After Alternator and Mutilator by minute 16, use Ascend to dive the enemy backline and Heresy to stay in the fight.
offlane.watchout: Most offlaners here beat you in long trades, so when Greystone or Steel commits, stop trading and keep Ascend ready to escape.

offlane.line: Finish minions with Siphon to collect Souls, and trade by landing Subjugate first, then Phantom Rush through them for the fear. After Orion and Timewarp by minute 16, follow Subjugate with Colossal Blow when it's ready to hit whoever is caught.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Grux and Aurora all win this lane early, so farm under your tower with Siphon and wait for your jungler.

jungle.line: Clear camps with Siphon to collect Souls, then gank by landing Subjugate first and Phantom Rush through them for the fear. After Orion and Timewarp by minute 15, end each gank with Colossal Blow while they're held in place.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Kwang and Serath beat you in a jungle duel, so ward your camps and leave when one of them shows up.

offlane.line: Mark your target with Line Tempo and Rushing Beat, start Circle Rhythm as you close in for the shield, then let All-Kill! finish them. After Orion and Timewarp by minute 16, all-in squishy targets and keep one Rushing Beat charge to leave.
offlane.watchout: If Greystone or Steel survives your combo, don't stay to finish; leave with the Rushing Beat charge you saved.

jungle.line: Gank from the side with Rushing Beat, send Line Tempo through the target, and use Circle Rhythm for the shield as they swing back; let All-Kill! finish. After Orion and Timewarp by minute 15, hunt squishy laners and leave tanks alone.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang win jungle duels against you, so avoid their camps and spend your time ganking lanes.

midlane.line: Poke with Line Tempo to mark them, then dash in with Rushing Beat and Circle Rhythm once All-Kill! can finish the job. After Orion and Timewarp by minute 15, push mid and roam to side lanes for picks.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and Iggy & Scorch outrange you, so stay behind minions and only dash in after they've used their abilities.

carry.line: Stick Plasma Grenade on a target, turn on Hypercharge and keep basic attacking, and use Air Assault to hover out of melee reach while you shoot. After Viper and Deathstalker by minute 16, stay in longer fights and finish runners with Atomiser.
carry.watchout: Sparrow, TwinBlast, Murdock and Drongo out-trade you early, so last-hit safely and only trade when your support engages first.

midlane.line: Poke with Plasma Grenade from range, turn on Hypercharge to trade, and save Atomiser to finish a low target. After Viper and Deathstalker by minute 16, use Air Assault to fight from above and look for kills in side lanes.
midlane.watchout: Most midlaners here beat you in lane, so against Renna or Gideon farm near your tower and skip trades until your items are done.

offlane.line: Trade from range with Plasma Grenade, then Hypercharge and basic attack; keep Air Assault to hover away when melee offlaners dash in. After Viper and Deathstalker by minute 16, fight from behind your team, not the front.
offlane.watchout: Every offlaner here wins this lane, so don't trade with Greystone or Steel; farm safely and ask your jungler for help.

carry.line: Drop Hail of Arrows on your target, then keep basic attacking to stack Relentless; use Heightened Senses to slip away when someone dives you. After Deathstalker and Viper by minute 16, start Inner Fire once the enemy frontline commits.
carry.watchout: Murdock wins your trades, so don't stand in front of the wave; let him waste his poke and fight when your support engages.

offlane.line: Poke from max range with Piercing Shot and Hail of Arrows, and basic attack to stack Relentless; save Heightened Senses for when they dash on you. After Deathstalker and Viper by minute 16, play behind your frontline and fire Inner Fire into the crowd.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel and Grux reach you easily in this lane, so stay near your tower and use Heightened Senses as soon as they commit.

midlane.line: Clear the wave with Hail of Arrows, then poke with a charged Piercing Shot and stack Relentless with basic attacks from a safe distance. After Deathstalker and Viper by minute 16, join fights from behind your team and fire Inner Fire.
midlane.watchout: Lt. Belica, Gideon and Iggy & Scorch out-damage you early, so farm safely and keep Heightened Senses for their gank attempts.

offlane.line: Charge in with Bull Rush, follow with Shield Bash, and drop Force Shield to block their ranged return fire. After Orion and Spectral Schematics by minute 16, open fights by landing Shield Slam on grouped enemies.
offlane.watchout: Bull Rush is your engage; if Greystone or Aurora dodges it, back off and wait for it to come back before trading again.

support.line: Engage with Bull Rush into the enemy carry, Shield Bash them, and place Force Shield between your carry and their projectiles. After Warp Stream and Stonewall by minute 16, start fights with Shield Slam and stand in front of your carry.
support.watchout: Dekker wins this lane, so don't charge in alone against her; engage only when your carry is close enough to follow up.

jungle.line: Gank with Bull Rush from behind the target, then Shield Bash, and use Force Shield to block their shots while your laner joins in. After Orion and Wraith Leggings by minute 15, open team fights with Shield Slam.
jungle.watchout: Kwang beats you in a jungle duel, so ward your camps and leave when he invades instead of fighting him alone.

offlane.line: Trade with Highland Hurl to slow, then Ruthless Assault up close to stack Hersir so your next ability is empowered. After Viper and Deathstalker by minute 16, engage with Wild Rush and use Unstoppable Force to cleanse and disable enemy towers while you push.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel and Aurora win long trades, so throw Highland Hurl from range and back off rather than going all in early.

jungle.line: Gank by charging Wild Rush from out of sight, then Highland Hurl to slow and Ruthless Assault to stack Hersir. After Viper and Deathstalker by minute 16, use Unstoppable Force to cleanse their stuns and roots and dive under enemy towers.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang beat you in jungle duels, so don't contest their camps; gank the other side of the map.

support.line: Engage with Wild Rush, slow with Highland Hurl, and let Ruthless Assault stack Hersir while your carry follows up. Once Stonewall and Raiment of Renewal are done by minute 19, stand in front and cast Unstoppable Force when you're slowed to cleanse it and gain armor for the fight.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker and Narbash win this lane, so stop starting trades against them and protect your carry until your jungler arrives.

midlane.line: Poke with Harvest Nettles on the same target to build its bonus, then drop Bramble Patch and Untamed Growth where they stand. After Combustion and Wraith Leggings by minute 16, open fights with Fly Trap to pull grouped enemies together.
midlane.watchout: Gideon outranges and out-damages you, so stay behind minions, save Bramble Patch for his engage, and wait for your jungler.

support.line: Slow the enemy duo with Bramble Patch, then follow with Untamed Growth and Harvest Nettles on the same target. After Warp Stream and Stonewall by minute 16, hold Fly Trap for when enemies group on your carry.
support.watchout: Dekker wins this lane, so stop trading into her; stay behind your carry and keep Bramble Patch for her engage.

offlane.line: Poke with Harvest Nettles on the same target, then drop Bramble Patch and Untamed Growth when they walk up to trade. After Combustion and Wraith Leggings by minute 16, open fights with Fly Trap on grouped enemies.
offlane.watchout: You have no dash, so if their jungler shows up mid-trade, stop poking and walk back to your tower immediately.

carry.line: Cast an ability before every trade so Gunslinger empowers your next basic attack, poking with Vaporize and Vortex Grenade; keep Rocket Dash to reposition. After Sky Splitter and Viper by minute 16, stay in fights longer and fire Ventilate into grouped enemies.
carry.watchout: Sparrow, Murdock and Drongo win your lane trades, so last-hit safely and only fight when your support starts it.

offlane.line: Poke with Vaporize and Vortex Grenade, then basic attack while Gunslinger is active, and save Rocket Dash to escape melee offlaners. After Sky Splitter and Viper by minute 16, fight from behind your team and fire Ventilate.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Grux and Aurora all beat you here, so farm under tower and stop trading once they close in.

midlane.line: Clear the wave with Vortex Grenade, poke with Vaporize, and follow each ability with an empowered Gunslinger basic attack. After Sky Splitter and Viper by minute 16, roam to side lanes and use Ventilate on grouped enemies.
midlane.watchout: Lt. Belica, Valmont, Gideon and Iggy & Scorch out-trade you early, so farm safely and save Rocket Dash for their engage.

midlane.line: Bind your target with Arterial Grip, follow with Rupture and Bloodbound, and use Exsanguinate to heal back what you lost. After Orion and Tainted Scepter by minute 15, roam to side lanes and look for picks.
midlane.watchout: Lt. Belica, Gideon, Iggy & Scorch and Gadget win this lane, so stay behind minions and trade only when they've used their abilities.

offlane.line: Trade short with Arterial Grip and Rupture, then use Exsanguinate to heal back the damage before they can respond. After Orion and Tainted Scepter by minute 16, look for picks on squishy targets from behind your frontline.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Grux and Aurora win this lane, so farm safely near your tower and wait for your jungler before trading.

support.line: Bind the enemy carry with Arterial Grip, poke with Rupture and Bloodbound, and use Exsanguinate to keep yourself in the lane. After Lifecore and Spirit Of Amir by minute 18, stay behind your carry and protect them.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker and Narbash win this lane, so stop starting trades against them and stay behind your carry until your jungler arrives.

carry.line: Poke from max range with Knock, Knock!, slow them with Peekaboo!, and use Surprise, Surprise! to reposition when someone dives you. After Deathstalker and Viper by minute 16, stay in longer fights and save Back It Up! for a key target.
carry.watchout: Sparrow, TwinBlast, Murdock and Drongo out-trade you early, so farm safely and only fight when your support engages.

midlane.line: Clear the wave with Peekaboo!, poke from max range with Knock, Knock!, and drop your Sonar Drone to spot ganks. After Deathstalker and Viper by minute 16, roam and use Back It Up! to pick off an isolated target.
midlane.watchout: Almost every midlaner here beats you, so against Renna or Gideon farm near tower and use Surprise, Surprise! to escape their engage.

support.line: Slow the enemy duo with Peekaboo!, snipe the marked target with Knock, Knock!, and place Sonar Drones to watch for ganks. Once Stonewall and Raiment of Renewal are done by minute 19, use Back It Up! to send a diving enemy back out.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn, Adele and Narbash all win this lane, so stop trading and play behind your carry until your jungler comes.

jungle.line: Gank by dashing in with Windsurge, then use Cyclebreaker's damage reduction as they fight back; every 5 hits on enemies spawns a clone, and 84000 Hairs switches your stance. After The Perforator and Spear Of Desolation by minute 16, hunt squishy targets.
jungle.watchout: Most junglers here win the straight duel, so ward your camps and gank lanes instead of fighting Khaimera or Kwang head-on.

offlane.line: Trade short with Windsurge and Cyclebreaker, using its damage reduction to take their return hits, then walk out. After The Perforator and Spear Of Desolation by minute 16, flank fights and go for squishy targets.
offlane.watchout: Every offlaner here wins this lane, so don't trade into Greystone or Steel; farm safely and wait for your jungler.

support.line: Engage with Windsurge to slow the enemy duo, then use Cyclebreaker to take less damage while you stand in front of your carry, and land its staff throw to stun. Once Stonewall and Warden's Faith are done by minute 19, switch stance with 84000 Hairs and fight from the front.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Narbash all win this lane, so stop starting trades against them and protect your carry until your jungler comes.

jungle.line: Gank by pulling in with Lash Kick, then chain three basic attacks for Windburn's bonus damage and heal while Rising Storm stacks. After Mutilator and Viper by minute 16, use Quelling Gale to fight through ranged enemies.
jungle.watchout: Most junglers here win the duel, so don't contest Khaimera or Kwang in their camps; gank lanes instead.

offlane.line: Pull in with Lash Kick, then chain basic attacks to trigger Windburn and stack Rising Storm; use Backlash to push them away when they fight back. Once Mutilator and The Perforator are done by minute 17, use Quelling Gale in team fights.
offlane.watchout: Every offlaner here wins this lane, so don't trade into Greystone or Steel; farm safely and wait for your jungler.

carry.line: Pull in with Lash Kick when your support engages, then chain basic attacks for Windburn's heal and Rising Storm stacks. After Mutilator and The Perforator by minute 16, turn on Quelling Gale to fight through ranged carries.
carry.watchout: Sparrow, Revenant, TwinBlast and Murdock outrange you in lane, so last-hit safely and wait for your support before using Lash Kick.

jungle.line: Mark targets with Whispering Echoes or Anima Burst, then use Severance into them to reset it and keep chasing. After Alternator and Basilisk by minute 16, use Soulstorm to pull grouped enemies together.
jungle.watchout: Most junglers here win the duel, so ward your camps and gank lanes instead of fighting Khaimera or Kwang head-on.

offlane.line: Mark them with Whispering Echoes, then Severance into them to reset it and follow with Anima Burst. After Alternator and Basilisk by minute 16, use Soulstorm to pull enemies together for your team.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Grux and Aurora win this lane, so trade only with Whispering Echoes from range and keep Severance to escape.

offlane.line: Close the gap with Evade, block their return damage with Barricade, then swing it back and throw Spear of Nyr when they run. After Alternator and The Perforator by minute 16, use Coliseum to trap a squishy target.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel and Aurora are even fights, so don't use Coliseum on them at full health; save it for a target already low.

jungle.line: Gank by dashing in with Evade, block their burst with Barricade, then finish runners with Spear of Nyr. After Alternator and The Perforator by minute 16, open fights with Coliseum on an isolated squishy target.
jungle.watchout: Kwang beats you in a jungle duel, so ward your camps and leave instead of fighting him head-on.

support.line: Engage with Coliseum on the enemy carry, use Barricade to soak their damage, and throw Spear of Nyr to finish runners. After Inquisition and Stonewall by minute 18, stand in front of your carry and absorb the fight.
support.watchout: Against Dekker it's an even lane, so don't engage alone; wait until your carry is in range to follow your Coliseum.

support.line: Stun with Ricochet, slow with Bad Medicine, and keep your carry topped up with Infuse; hold Neural Regenesis for an ally about to die. After Lifecore and Lunaria by minute 17, stay behind your team and heal through fights.
support.watchout: Every support here wins this lane, so stop trading; stay behind your carry and save Ricochet for their engage.

offlane.line: Poke with Ricochet and Bad Medicine, then back off between trades instead of trading health. After Combustion and Noxia by minute 16, hit squishy targets from behind your frontline.
offlane.watchout: Every offlaner here wins this lane, so don't trade with Greystone or Steel; farm safely and save Neural Regenesis for when they dive.

midlane.line: Clear the wave with Bad Medicine, then poke with Ricochet when it can bounce off minions into them. After Combustion and Noxia by minute 15, join side-lane fights.
midlane.watchout: Every midlaner here wins the lane, so farm near your tower and save Neural Regenesis for when they dive you.
